summary: Iteration 23 — Validated POST /api/auth/resend-verification (all 6 cases) + non-regression on register/verify/login/guide/legacy routes + frontend 'Renvoyer le lien' button. 9 new pytest cases pass; total backend suite: 54 passed, 3 skipped (the 3 skipped are TestRedeployHappyPath which intentionally skip without real DEPLOY_SECRET — exceeds the requested 40/8 baseline). Playwright confirmed: signup → waiting-banner with 'Expire dans 05:00' countdown → click [data-testid=resend-link-btn] → countdown resets to ~05:00 + new demo link generated + toast 'Nouveau lien généré (mode démo).' Backend 429 rate-limit (3/10min/email) verified directly via pytest (test_rate_limit_4th_call_is_429). Old token correctly invalidated on resend (verification-status returns 'expired' or 'invalid', old verify-email link → 400). Code-review on /auth/resend-verification: clean implementation, neutral message for unknown/verified emails (no enumeration), proper 5-min TTL, resend_attempts index created at startup.

integration_issues.issue: Race-condition: when a user clicks 'Renvoyer le lien' multiple times in rapid succession, the polling timer occasionally observes the OLD verification_token between handleResend's stopWaiting() and startWaiting(newToken) (or between backend delete_many() and insert_one() of the new email_verifications row), receives status='expired', and closes the banner via stopWaiting(). User then sees the registration form again instead of the new countdown. Reproduces ~50% of the time when clicking ≥3 times within 4s. Real users typing emails would rarely hit this; backend rate-limit (3/10min) is correct and verified.

action_items: (Optional, low priority) In Login.js handleResend catch-block: when err.response?.status === 429, do NOT modify waitingFor — current code correctly only shows toast.error, but consider also disabling resend-link-btn for the cooldown window (10 min) by storing rate-limit-until in state. Currently the button stays clickable and each click immediately yields a 429 toast.

(Optional) In server.py /auth/resend-verification: swap the order to insert_one(new_token) BEFORE delete_many(old) — eliminates the tiny window where polling on the old token returns 'expired'. Or inline an atomic replace_one. Not blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:609-676 — resend_verification implementation is clean: validates email regex, enforces 3/10min rate-limit on db.resend_attempts, neutral response for unknown/verified emails (no enumeration), generates a fresh 32-byte token with 5-min TTL, deletes any prior email_verifications row for this user before inserting the new one. The 'frontend_url' fallback chain (payload → FRONTEND_URL env → REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env) is robust. Returns expires_in_seconds=300 as required.

server.py:2789 — new index db.resend_attempts.create_index('email') created at startup. No TTL index on resend_attempts.ts; rows accumulate forever. Suggest add a 24h TTL index (create_index('ts', expireAfterSeconds=86400)) to keep the collection bounded. Low priority hygiene.
server.py global cleanup verified: ruff lint 100% clean, no F821 / unreachable-code warnings. The 133-line dead-code block claimed removed in /export/mobile/ confirmed absent.

Login.js:176-203 (handleResend) — minor improvement: in the 429 catch path, do not immediately re-enable the button; debounce or honour Retry-After header. Backend currently does not emit Retry-After.
server.py is still 2798 lines. Extracting routes/auth_email.py and routes/guide.py would simplify maintenance. Carried over from previous iterations.
